name: Check that agent file tools cannot reach outside the workspace
description: An AI agent tries to reach files outside its workspace with absolute paths, ../ traversal, and Glob and Grep searches of /etc. Every attempt must be refused, and a control write inside the workspace must succeed. Run it after upgrading ByteChef to confirm the workspace still confines the file tools.
shortDescription: Confirms the file tools refuse absolute paths and ../ traversal out of the workspace.
keyFeatures: Absolute path and ../ traversal attempts for every file tool
Glob and Grep searches outside the workspace
A control write inside the workspace
PASS/FAIL report in the execution log
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.file-system.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED), which turns on the File System, Glob, Grep and List Directory tools
idealFor: Administrators of self-hosted ByteChef who want to check how the Agent Utils file and shell tools behave before they let agent builders use them.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Run the checks: the AI Agent attempts seven escapes from its workspace and one allowed write.
Log the report: the Logger step prints the agent's PASS/FAIL table to the execution log.
